title: Move board, frame and project navigation checks out of Dashboard Integrated UI Test

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-334#move-navigation-checks-and-retire-integrated-ui-test (plan .planning/slice-plans/648-move-navigation-checks-and-retire-integrated-ui-test/PLAN.md)
Checked revision: 00cdf46a6b076b31959a631aac29d3d8a4719b2f (branch claude/move-board-frame-and-project-navigation-checks-o), in an isolated detached scratch worktree at /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/642c3e21/tmp/ic-scratch (npm ci, Node v24.21.0 per .node-version); worktree removed afterwards.

Promise (key example 1): the chosen Board columns stay across a project switch; after conversion the assertion runs in a named Frontend case against real browser storage.

Verdict: Caught.
The maintained assertion that caught it: dashboard/frontend-tests/navigation/board-kept-position.spec.ts, test "the chosen Board columns stay across a project switch", line 47 `await expectAtTaken(page)` right after `chooseProject(page, "Doughnut")` (failing inside helper expectView, tests/boardPage.ts:49, column paging controls expected ["Backlog 2 entries"], received ["Recently done 0 entries"], i.e. the Board showed Backlog/Taken instead of Taken/Recently done). The test "where the browser refuses storage, ..." (line 122) also failed at its post-switch expectAtTaken with the same mismatch, covering the page-lifetime (no storage) path of the same promise. Claim limited to the narrow-window (two of three columns) Open Dough -> Doughnut switch after paging to Taken.

Next proof action: none required for this promise; the maintained check catches a project-switch reset of the kept position.

Fault (suggested fault validated, form revised):
- First attempt (suggested "reset on project change"): passed sourceId from dashboard/src/Board.tsx into useColumnPaging and reset position via a useLayoutEffect when the scope ref changed. All 6 tests passed, and an independent scratch witness showed Taken/Recently done still shown with kept "1" after switching to Doughnut: the fault never fired because the Board's paging state starts fresh per project (the ref is initialized to the new project), so it produced no wrong behavior and gave no verdict.
- Probe fault used: dashboard/src/Board.tsx `useColumnPaging(summaries.length, sourceId)`; dashboard/src/columnPaging.ts adds a module-level `lastScope` and, in the position useState initializer, when the project differs from the last one, calls `keptPosition.choose(0)` before reading, so the kept position resets to Backlog on a project switch (both in storage and on-page fallback). Fixtures and assertions untouched.

Independent wrong-behavior witness: temporary scratch spec (frontend-tests/navigation/zz-ic-witness.spec.ts, deleted afterwards) with listThreeProjects, narrow window, page to Recently done, then record column geometry against .board-view and localStorage "open-dough.board.position" before and after chooseProject("Doughnut"). Under the probe fault: before ["Backlog:hidden","Taken:shown","Recently done:shown"], kept "1"; after switch ["Backlog:shown","Taken:shown","Recently done:hidden"], kept "0" - Doughnut started at Backlog, the promised behavior went wrong on the intended path.

Reach: baseline run of the focused command passed all 6 tests (test 1 at 6.2s), exercising the project-switch path; under the fault test 1 failed specifically at the post-switch assertion, after the pre-switch expectAtTaken passed.

Restoration: git checkout of both product files, witness spec and test-results removed; `git status --short --untracked-files=all` and `git diff --stat` empty (matching the clean pre-probe state recorded after npm ci); the same focused command then passed 6/6 (16.7s). Execution checkout was never edited (note: it now shows unrelated modifications to .planning/PRODUCT-BACKLOG.md and DearDough.md, not made by this probe).

Already-planned repair / prior disposition: the execution's only scratch break for this file renamed the former storage key and exercised the former-key case; this probe adds the project-switch catch and does not overlap a planned repair. No new repair decision arises.

Command (from dashboard/): env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES caffeinate -i npx playwright test --config frontend.playwright.config.ts frontend-tests/navigation/board-kept-position.spec.ts --reporter=list --workers=1 (load averages ~13-16 at baseline).

- Human effort: unavailable; no human participated during the probe (0 interventions observed).
- Agent effort: unavailable as tokens/cost (no supported meter in this session); measured as 13 tool calls.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 240622 ms (measured), from 1794934129416 to 1794934370038 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
